# Lint rules

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-lint-docs.js — do not edit by hand. -->

Every diagnostic has a stable ID (`YL…`) and a name. Either can be used to change its severity in `.yaral-lint.json` or VS Code settings, or in suppression comments:

```jsonc
{ "rules": { "YL506": "off", "unused-placeholder": "error" } }
```

```yaral
// yaral-lint-disable-next-line YL205
$e.principal.hostname = $host

$e.target.ip = $ip // yaral-lint-disable-line unused-placeholder

// yaral-lint-disable YL208   (anywhere in the file: whole-file suppression)
```

Severities: `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint`, `off`. The CLI exits non-zero on errors (and on warnings above `--max-warnings`).

## Syntax

| ID | Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="yl001"></a>YL001 | `syntax-error` | error | Lexical or structural syntax error (unbalanced brackets, unterminated strings, malformed rule header). |

## Structure

| ID | Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="yl101"></a>YL101 | `missing-section` | error | A rule must have `events:` and `condition:` sections. |
| <a id="yl102"></a>YL102 | `section-order` | error | Sections must appear in the order meta, events, match, outcome, condition, options. |
| <a id="yl103"></a>YL103 | `duplicate-section` | error | A section is declared more than once. |
| <a id="yl104"></a>YL104 | `empty-section` | warning | A section header has no content. |
| <a id="yl105"></a>YL105 | `filename-rule-name` | warning | The file name should equal the rule name so rules can be found and deployed by name. |
| <a id="yl106"></a>YL106 | `rule-name-format` | warning | Rule names should be lower snake_case identifiers. |
| <a id="yl107"></a>YL107 | `multiple-rules` | warning | Keep exactly one rule per file; the SecOps API manages rules individually. |

## Variables

| ID | Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="yl201"></a>YL201 | `undefined-variable` | error | A variable is used but never defined in `events:` or `outcome:`. |
| <a id="yl202"></a>YL202 | `unused-event-variable` | warning | Every event variable declared in `events:` should be referenced in `condition:`. |
| <a id="yl203"></a>YL203 | `undefined-match-variable` | error | Match variables must be placeholders assigned in `events:`. |
| <a id="yl204"></a>YL204 | `duplicate-outcome` | error | An outcome variable is assigned more than once. |
| <a id="yl205"></a>YL205 | `unused-placeholder` | warning | A placeholder variable is assigned but never used for a join, match, outcome or condition. |
| <a id="yl206"></a>YL206 | `non-aggregated-outcome` | warning | In rules with `match:`, event fields in outcomes must be wrapped in an aggregate function (max, array_distinct, ...). |
| <a id="yl207"></a>YL207 | `variable-case-collision` | info | Two variables differ only by capitalization (e.g. $Host and $host). |
| <a id="yl208"></a>YL208 | `generic-event-variable` | hint | Prefer descriptive event variable names ($login, $process) over $e / $e1 / $event. |

## Functions, regular expressions & performance

| ID | Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="yl301"></a>YL301 | `unknown-function` | warning | Function is not in the YARA-L function catalog (add custom ones under `functions` in .yaral-lint.json). |
| <a id="yl302"></a>YL302 | `argument-count` | error | Function is called with the wrong number of arguments. |
| <a id="yl303"></a>YL303 | `function-section` | warning | Function is used in a section where it is not allowed (e.g. aggregates outside `outcome:`). |
| <a id="yl304"></a>YL304 | `invalid-regex` | warning | Regular expression is invalid or uses features RE2 does not support (lookaround, backreferences). |
| <a id="yl305"></a>YL305 | `regex-wildcard-edges` | info | Leading or trailing `.*` in a regex is redundant (YARA-L regexes match substrings) and slows evaluation. |
| <a id="yl306"></a>YL306 | `missing-event-filter` | info | Event variable has no metadata filter (event_type, log_type, product_name ...), so the rule must evaluate every event. |
| <a id="yl307"></a>YL307 | `entity-graph-filter` | info | Entity graph variables should filter on graph.metadata.entity_type and graph.metadata.source_type. |

## Meta

| ID | Name | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="yl401"></a>YL401 | `missing-required-meta` | warning | A meta key required by .yaral-lint.json is missing. |
| <a id="yl402"></a>YL402 | `missing-conventional-meta` | info | A meta key used by most rules in the workspace is missing. |
| <a id="yl403"></a>YL403 | `invalid-meta-value` | warning | A meta value is not one of the allowed values. |
| <a id="yl404"></a>YL404 | `meta-pattern` | warning | A meta value does not match the pattern configured in .yaral-lint.json. |
| <a id="yl405"></a>YL405 | `duplicate-meta` | warning | A meta key is defined more than once. |
| <a id="yl406"></a>YL406 | `meta-key-typo` | info | A meta key is not used elsewhere in the workspace but is close to a common key (possible typo). |
| <a id="yl407"></a>YL407 | `duplicate-rule-identity` | error | rule name or meta rule_id duplicates another rule in the workspace. |
| <a id="yl408"></a>YL408 | `mitre-unknown-id` | warning | tactic/technique value is not a valid ID in the enabled MITRE frameworks (ATT&CK Enterprise, ICS, Mobile, ATLAS). |
| <a id="yl409"></a>YL409 | `mitre-deprecated` | warning | MITRE technique is revoked or deprecated; revoked techniques link to their replacement. |
| <a id="yl410"></a>YL410 | `mitre-name-instead-of-id` | warning | Use MITRE IDs (TA0006, T1110, AML.T0051) rather than names in tactic/technique meta. |
| <a id="yl411"></a>YL411 | `mitre-tactic-mismatch` | info | None of the technique's tactics are listed in the rule's tactic meta. |
| <a id="yl412"></a>YL412 | `mitre-meta-key` | info | Use the configured MITRE meta keys (tactic/technique by default) instead of alternatives such as mitre_attack_tactic. |
